description:
Create a Balanced Scorecard (BSC) strategy map for a hospital's digital transformation. 

1. Open the template file '~/Diagrams/hospital_strategy_map.drawio' which contains empty swim lanes.
2. Read the strategic plan at '~/Desktop/strategic_plan.txt'.
3. Add the 16 strategic objectives to the correct perspective lanes (Financial, Customer, Internal Processes, Learning & Growth).
4. Create rounded rectangles for each objective and label them exactly as listed.
5. Draw the 17 cause-and-effect arrows specified in the plan.
6. Color code the shapes by perspective as requested (Gold, Blue, Green, Orange).
7. Export the final diagram as a PDF to '~/Diagrams/hospital_strategy_map.pdf'.
